# Should we build a compliance product for veterinary practices

*deep · 6 angles · 11 sources (4 via Bright Data) · 5 disconfirming searches*

## Could not answer

Nothing cleared the confidence floor. Every source on pricing and demand traced
back to one vendor's marketing, and no independent practitioner evidence surfaced
across six angles. Ranked findings here would read as confidence the evidence
never had.

Closest thing found: two practitioner threads suggesting a scheduling problem
rather than a compliance one, both sub-floor on their own.
